items.Title: Data Scientist, Senior Associate
items.ExternalDescriptionStr:
Job summary:
As a Senior Associate for our CCB Affluent Data & Analytics team you will have an opportunity to support the Affluent channel initiatives within the CCB Affluent segment.  You will partner with Affluent strategy, Sales, and Product / Program teams to solve key business problems utilizing data-driven approaches.  You'll drive analyses for sales journeys, Program Expansion, as well as banker / affluent channel studies with a focus on productivity and optimization.  You will partner directly with our internal clients to develop, implement, and track strategic initiatives from a data & analytics perspective while owning the end to end analytics journey to produce insights. This role requires strong analytical and technical skills, excellent problem-solving abilities, and effective communication skills. 


Job responsibilities:

  • Partner with business and technology teams to set quantifiable goals, advise on strategies, and experiments to achieve business objectives.
  • Act as subject matter expert and drive analytics efforts to produce affluent channel and banker level insights. 
  • Lead execution of KPIs, trend analysis, and dashboards to improve and monitor business performance.
  • Communicating and interfacing with stakeholders, leveraging a blend of analytical skills and business acumen to produce impactful results.
  • Partner with stakeholders to solve quantitative problems related to optimizing business processes and performance insights using various analytic methods.
  • End to End project ownership, encompassing tasks such as gathering detailed requirements, data preparation, result generation, and data visualization. 
  • Uphold the highest standards of data integrity and security, aligning with both internal and external regulatory requirements and compliance protocols.

  • Stay updated on industry trends as well as test new tools and techniques to address business challenges.

     

 Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills:

  • Masters in a related field, or Bachelors with 3+ years of experience in a related discipline (Computer Science, Operational Research, Physics, Mathematics, Neuroscience, Engineering, Econometrics, Statistics, Other Sciences etc.) or equivalent
  • Strong proficiency in mix of programming languages and Business Intelligence (BI) tools such as SQL, Python, Tableau, and/or Alteryx.
  • Experience defining business KPIs and establishing measurement frameworks.
  • Proven ability to work in a fast-paced environment, meet deadlines. Must be detail oriented, organized, and perform at high standards.
  • Proficiency in Advanced Statistical methods and concepts, predictive modeling, time series forecasting, and/or text mining
  • Experience in Cloud and Big Data platforms such as AWS, Snowflake, Hadoop, Hive, Pig, Apache Spark, etc.
  • Strong story telling skills including communicating complex concepts effectively to CCB business stakeholders.
